title: First Light Under Dead Stone
description: Aten Ra advances through sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and formation answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover

objectives.primary: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.
optional: Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Momentum, Divinity, or terrain reactions

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone Titan holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Hollow Drift: enemies punish exposed Titan positioning and reckless routes.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.

activeTitanPolicy.rosterPurpose: Choose the best single Titan before launch; roster depth changes approach, not on-field body count.
